title: Web Fiction Platforms (2025)
use_cases: Use when selecting a platform based on genre compatibility like LitRPG or Romance
Implement when transitioning from fanfiction (AO3) to original fiction (Fictionpress)
Configure when setting up monetization through subscriber-only exclusives and early access
Use when choosing between self-hosted author sites and hosted social platforms
Use when evaluating distribution channels for mobile-first audiences like Tapas or GoodNovel
content:
- Ream / Patreon https://reamstories.com/ https://patreon.com Popular genres: Any—depends on creatorNot for initial discovery; monetizes an existing fanbase with early pages, exclusives, and community content.
- Author Site with Email(varies; user-hosted)Popular genres: AnyMaximum control; need to drive your own discovery and manage an email list for retention.
- Webnovel https://www.webnovel.com/ Popular genres: Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Drama, RomanceLeading platform for translated web novels; paid unlocks and VIP tiers.
- AO3 (Archive of Our Own) https://archiveofourown.org/ Popular genres: Fanfiction (all genres)No monetization; respected for robust tagging and community moderation.
- Scribble Hub https://www.scribblehub.com/ Popular genres: Action, Adventure, FantasyKnown for niche subgenres, LGBTQ+ stories, active forums.
- Moonquill https://www.moonquill.com/ Popular genres: Romance, Fantasy, Sci-FiFlexible posting; supportive staff and eBook options.
- Pratilipi https://english.pratilipi.com/ Popular genres: Thriller, Romance, Horror (Indian Fiction)Multilingual; robust Indian and diaspora community.
- Neovel https://neoread.neovel.io/home Popular genres: Action, Adventure, Romance, FantasyFrench-based, growing English section; strong author tools.
- Fictionpress https://www.fictionpress.com Popular genres: Romance, Fantasy, YASister site to FanFiction.net, focused on original stories.
- Quotev https://www.quotev.com Popular genres: Fanfiction, Romance, AnimeSocial features and quizzes; highly popular among fanfiction communities.
- Muses Success https://muses-success.info Popular genres: Fantasy, Sci-FiCatalog and database for discovering and tracking web fiction.
- Top Web Fiction http://topwebfiction.com/ Popular genres: Fantasy, Sci-Fi, YA, RomanceAggregates web serials for voting and discovery.
- Honeyfeed https://www.honeyfeed.fm/ranking/monthly Popular genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, School, SupernaturalFocuses on anime-style original English web novels.
- Good Novel https://www.goodnovel.com/more/rankings Popular genres: Fantasy (Werewolves), Romance (CEO)Strong mobile presence; popular for romance/fantasy serialization.
- Penana https://www.penana.com/home Popular genres: Fanfiction, Fantasy, Horror, Romance, MatureCommunity contests and collaborative options; broad genre selection.
- Inkitt https://www.inkitt.com/ Popular genres: Fantasy (mainly Werewolves), Mature Romance, SupernaturalData-driven reader feedback influences publishing opportunities.
- Fictionate.me https://fictionate.me/ Popular genres: Romance, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, MysteryUser-friendly interface; features a royalty payment system for writers.
- Royal Road https://www.royalroad.com/ Popular genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, DramaSFF-focused; top site for progression fantasy, LitRPG, and dungeon core serials.
- Tapas https://tapas.io/ Popular genres: Fantasy, LGBTQ+, Romance, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, MysteryAlso specializes in comics and illustrated content; mobile-friendly experience.
- Wattpad https://www.wattpad.com/ Popular genres: YA/RomanceStrong global reach; many stories adapted into books, TV, and film.
